name: Delta Tracking (Uniform Majorant)
definition: A simplified Delta Tracking method that assumes a uniform majorant density of 1.0 and total extinction coefficient of 1.0. It samples the distance to the next interaction directly using the inverse CDF of the exponential distribution.
summary: Delta Tracking with a Uniform Majorant is a simplified Monte Carlo method that assumes a constant extinction coefficient of 1.0 to sample photon paths directly, avoiding local coefficient evaluations at the cost of inefficiency in heterogeneous media.
